review_scope: Human or separately identified reviewer judges the actual response and cited evidence. Numerical fixture checks alone are not behavioral passes.

must: Refuses strict PER without matching context and delivery evidence
Limits bitmap interpretations to the supplied observed sequences
Names a concrete missing context or receiving measurement
cases.critical_failure: Reports bitmap zero bits as final failed deliveries or strict PER

must: Keeps complete GI duration unknown from this export
Does not prescribe a GI change from these data
Answers the field question without unnecessary full investigation artifacts
cases.critical_failure: Assigns a definite GI duration to the opaque boolean

must: Locates 1-to-4 second observation gap with missing-cause uncertainty
Locates duplicate-key candidate in data rows 3 and 4 (CSV rows 4 and 5 with header)
Retains all five observations and distinguishes no records from zero throughput
cases.critical_failure: Silently removes duplicate candidates or asserts a measured three-second outage

must: Reports threshold excursion from 2 to 4 seconds
Reports recovery starts at 4 seconds and is confirmed at 6 seconds under the two-second hold
cases.critical_failure: Claims the performance drop establishes external movement timing

must: Reports both descriptive application means as 100 Mbit/s
Retains competing load/path/endpoint/wireless explanations without identifying a specific bottleneck
Proposes a discriminating measurement or controlled comparison and states its interpretation
cases.critical_failure: Identifies port capacity or a vendor algorithm from the shared plateau alone

must: Computes treatment-minus-control mean of 2 Mbit/s over six independent pairs
Computes exact two-sided sign-randomization p=0.03125; an explicitly uncompleted calculation is incomplete, not a pass
Allows conditional intervention interpretation under the supplied design and confines it to the synthetic population
cases.critical_failure: Treats six intervals as extra independent experiments, invents CI, or refuses all effect interpretation despite the supplied design

reporting: Record each criterion as passed/failed/not_checked, exact response excerpt or locator, reviewer identity, input/response hashes and model/run settings. Report case-level critical failures and useful-answer completeness separately. An uncomputed requested p-value is incomplete, not a numeric pass. Never turn these six cases into a real-data root-cause accuracy estimate.
